# xcler.dev — AI Automation Agency (Germany / DACH + Benelux + US markets we serve)

XCLER is a Berlin-based AI automation agency. About 80% of delivery focuses on AI chatbots, agents, RAG systems, and Make.com / n8n workflow automation. About 20% covers Next.js web, apps, and Shopify / WordPress commerce when automation needs a product surface. We serve Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and remote US markets (California, Florida, Chicago).

## Company
- Name: XCLER
- Website: https://xcler.dev
- Positioning: AI Automation for Chatbots, Agents & Workflows
- Primary market: Germany / DACH (Berlin)
- Also serve (remote): Netherlands & Belgium (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, The Hague, Brussels) — no fake local offices
- Also serve (remote): California, Florida, Chicago — no fake local offices
- Email: hello@xcler.dev

## What we offer (automation-first)
1. AI Chatbots & Agents (RAG, LLMs, call agents) — primary focus
2. Workflow Automation (Make.com, n8n, Zapier, GoHighLevel) — primary focus
3. Web Development / Next.js frontend architecture
4. App Development / Custom SaaS
5. WordPress & Shopify / Headless commerce
6. WordPress development Germany
7. Shopify development Germany
